description: This file implements a Consul-based membership table for Orleans, managing silo registration data, updates, and cleanup operations using Consul KV store.

classes.name: ConsulBasedMembershipTable
classes.description: A partial class implementing IMembershipTable using Consul for Orleans silo membership management.

methods.name: ConsulBasedMembershipTable
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Consul-based membership table with logger, options, and cluster info.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the membership table; no operation for Consul.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific silo registration row from Consul.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads all silo registrations from Consul.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Inserts a new silo registration entry into Consul.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Updates an existing silo registration in Consul.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the liveness status of a silo in Consul.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all membership entries for a cluster from Consul.

methods.name: GetTableVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the current table version from Consul KV entries.

methods.name: GetVersionRowUpdate
methods.description: Creates a KV transaction operation to update the table version.

methods.name: GetConsulSiloRegistration
methods.description: Retrieves silo registration data and version from Consul for a given silo address.

methods.name: AssembleMembershipTableData
methods.description: Constructs MembershipTableData from silo registrations and version.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes stale silo entries from Consul based on a cutoff date.
